newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes sharply higher on poll rally.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes sharply higher on poll rally.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index posted strong gains on Monday after a formidable showing by Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus's Civic Democratic Party (ODS) in the first round of Senate elections at the weekend.
The PX50 index climbed 2.5 percent to 498.7 while the major issue dominated RPIX rose 2.62 percent to 1,018.7.

Dealers said the elections had had a disproportionately encouraging effect on domestic investors who were reponsible for most of Monday's buying. Foreign investors, they said, would probably wait for the final ballot this coming weekend.
"This was just the first round and (the vote) isn't won yet," said Jan Sykora of Wood & Company in Prague.

Lubomir Vystavel of ING Baring said that a wave of speculative buying had been expected if the Prime Minster's party did well and predicted a more bullish mood in the market should there be a repeat performance in the final round.
"There could be continued buying after the second round of Senate elections if investors are happy (with the outcome)," he said.
The biggest gainer among the major issues was SPT Telecom - the most heavily capitalised share on the index.
SPT closed 114 crowns, 4.1 percent, higher at 2,869. CEZ gained 14 crowns to 951, Ceska Sporitelna rose eight crowns to 304 and Komercni Banka added 13 crowns to 2,051.
